P.name: Stage Presence
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Echo:}} '''Seraphine's''' {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts each generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Echo'', stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, the next basic ability cast consumes them all to cast an additional time at no cost after a {{rutngt|0.01}} delay. '''Seraphine''' gains maximum stacks of ''Echo'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]].
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Harmony:}} '''Seraphine's''' ability casts grant a ''Note'' to herself and nearby allied {{tip|champions}} that lasts 6 seconds, refreshes on subsequent ''Notes'' and stacks up to 4 times on each unit.
P.description3: While any amount of ''Notes'' are active, '''Seraphine's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' attack range}} per ''Note'', and fire all ''Notes'' at the target, with each one dealing {{as|{{pp|4 + (25-4)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 4% AP)}} magic damage|magic damage}}, reduced by 75% for ''Notes'' from allies.

Q.name: High Note
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Seraphine''' hurls a soundwave to the target location that upon arrival expands in a radius over {{fd|0.4}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area.
Q.description2: Against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, the damage is {{ccs|increased|magic}} by {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 75 for 11|0 to 75|formula=7.5% per 7.5% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 75% '''missing''' health|color=health}}.

W.name: Surround Sound
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Seraphine''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to herself and nearby allied champions for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. For the same duration, she also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|decaying '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and grants other allies {{as|{{ap|20*0.4}}%|ms}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*0.4}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
W.description2: If '''Seraphine''' already had a {{tip|shield}} at the time of cast, ''Surround Sound'' will pulse after the duration, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and nearby allied champions.
W.description3: ''Surround Sound's shield and {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} can stack up to 2 times. '''Seraphine''' can move during Surround Sound's cast time.''

E.name: Beat Drop
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Seraphine''' fires a heavy soundwave in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% for a few seconds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 190}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|70*0.7 to 190*0.7}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.7}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1.1 to 1.5}} seconds}}
E.description2: Enemies that are already {{tip|slow|slowed}} are also {{tip|root|rooted}} for the same duration.
E.description3: Enemies that are {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for the same duration.

R.name: Encore
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Seraphine''' projects a captivating force in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|charm|charms}} them, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for a duration, increasing by 15% every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over the duration up to 99%.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 250}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1.25 to 1.75}} seconds}}
R.description2: ''Encore's'' projectile resets its remaining travel distance whenever it hits an allied or enemy {{tip|champion}}, excluding '''Seraphine'''. Allied champions hit gain 4 ''{{ai|Stage Presence|Seraphine|Notes}}''.
